installation_policy: Run Python and pip with PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1.
Install the already frozen SNPPar source revision with --no-deps.
authorized_change.reason: Bring the smoke environment into compliance with SNPPar's own declared dependency bounds and prevent user-site package leakage.

required_validation: The SNPPar source pin must remain unchanged.
The SNPPar source tree must not be patched.
Python user-site packages must be disabled.
Biopython must resolve to version 1.76 inside the isolated environment.
TreeTime must resolve to version 0.8.5 inside the isolated environment.
ETE3 must resolve to version 3.1.3 inside the isolated environment.
The original failed smoke attempt must remain preserved.
No benchmark truth or full benchmark dataset may be used during this amendment.

triggering_observations.initial_smoke_failure: The first smoke environment contained Biopython 1.86 and loaded Bio from the user site, which is outside SNPPar's declared Biopython range and lacks Bio.Alphabet.
